draft.title: Issues with Qwen3 30B A3B model getting stuck in Open WebUI when ‘thinking’ is enabled
draft.body: I came across a report from May 2025 where a user updated their Open WebUI docker setup and loaded the 8.0 gguf quant of the Qwen3 30B A3B model. They noted that Open WebUI connected fine and requests could be sent, with the “thinking” progress showing. However, when the thinking feature was active, the model would eventually stop generating mid-sentence and get stuck indefinitely, with the progress indicator never completing. Interestingly, sending requests without thinking enabled worked normally, and the model also worked fine on other front ends like SillyTavern and VS Code extensions. Since the exact Open WebUI version, server specs, and config details weren’t provided, it’s unclear if this is a compatibility issue, a bug, or a resource limitation. Has anyone else encountered this stuck generation problem with Qwen3 30B A3B in Open WebUI? Are there known workarounds or config tweaks that might help the thinking feature operate smoothly? Any insights on debugging this or similar front-end integration quirks would be appreciated.
